title: Buckwheat with Chicken Breast & Veggies
description: Tender chicken breast cubes roasted with tomatoes and bell pepper, served with buckwheat. Simple and high-protein meal prep.

mealPrep.reheatNotes: Reheat in a pan over medium heat or microwave for 2 minutes.

steps: Cook in a pot with 1:2 water ratio over medium heat until all water is absorbed, about 15–20 minutes.
Season with salt, fluff with a fork, and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little oil.
Add chicken cubes, season with salt and black pepper.
Add tomatoes and bell pepper to the pan.
Roast together, stirring occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender but not dry, about 10–12 minutes.
Top each with chicken and vegetables.
